Class ShopDetailRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.dianping.shopdetail.repository.ShopDetailRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShopDetailRepository
@Repository public class ShopDetailRepositoryImpl extends java.lang.Object implements ShopDetailRepository
商详读取直接映射为领域数据，不调用遗留 Service 或请求线程身份。
